content.comment_body: Instructions for updating screen resolution for [product_name] [version_no]. For example, with a 4K monitor, the application may be difficult to read. On Windows 10, navigate to Disk C > Program Files > [company_name] > [product_name]_[version_no]. Open the folder and locate the 'Start' file. Right-click 'Start', select 'Properties', and open the 'Compatibility' tab. Then select 'Change high DPI settings', check 'High DPI scaling override', and choose 'System'. Confirm, apply changes, and restart the PC. If icons and text on the desktop are too small, right-click an empty area of the desktop and select 'Display settings'. Adjust 'Scale and layout' to a value above 100% (such as 150% or 200%) as needed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter readability problems with [product_name] [version_no] on high-resolution monitors, noticing that the interface becomes too small to use comfortably. The suggested workaround involves modifying Windows DPI scaling settings, highlighting that the application's support for modern display resolutions is lacking. This solution adds extra steps for users and is not fully effective when default scaling does not address the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the application to automatically adjust for high-resolution displays and remain easily readable without needing manual configuration.
